title: GoOrganicAfrica Algeria calculator readiness research — Batch 35
executive_summary: Updated Algeria's evidence record with 2024 RGA census progress, FAO 2025 cereal estimates and 2026 outlook, MADRP retail-price bulletin, ITGC 2024/25 cost-sheet methodology, and the 69-wilaya legal reorganisation. Added 69 wilayas to the region lookup. Final census tables, numerical ITGC cost sheets, farmgate prices and validated regional budgets remain outstanding.

geography.legal_source: Law No. 26-06, Official Journal No. 25, 5 April 2026
geography.transition: Parent wilayas continue to administer new wilayas during installation; transfer deadline is 31 December 2026. Interior Ministry reported installations for several newly promoted wilayas in late September 2026.

census.title: General Agricultural Census 2024
census.caveat: Interim fieldwork progress, not final census total; final crop and regional tables not extracted.

crop_evidence.caveat: National crop-specific production estimates; no matching harvested-area denominators in this brief, so no yield calculated.

outlook_2026.caveat: Forecast, not final output; aggregate not split into individual crops.

price_evidence.caveat: All are retail observations, not farmgate prices; green beans are not dry cowpea and broiler meat is not live-bird price.

cost_evidence.scope: Per-hectare technical itineraries and costs; separate machinery rented from machinery owned; schedules updated when input prices change.
cost_evidence.caveat: Numerical schedule extraction pending; these are technical reference budgets, not automatically observed farmer expenses.

safeguards: Do not convert national production totals into yields without matching harvested area.
Do not use the 2026 aggregate cereal forecast as crop-specific production.
Do not use national retail prices as farmgate prices.
Keep ITGC technical reference costs distinct from observed farmer expenses.
Use 69 wilayas under the 2026 law; preserve the transition note through 31 December 2026.
No active calculator profiles or formulas changed.
